ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity black (approx. 95% surface area) to high-intensity white punctate regions (approx. 5% surface area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black field covering the entire visible ventral surface with a stochastic distribution of fine white mottling and small contiguous clusters of 2-10 pixel width scattered primarily in the lower quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both trailing edges; notable high-amplitude indentation (notching) at the distal outer edge of the left lobe (viewer perspective).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve with an upward sweep reaching maximum height at the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a largely linear horizontal orientation before the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread distribution of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-5 pixel diameter) consistent with barnacle scar artifacts across the entire dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several visible vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) predominantly on the lower-inner portion of the left lobe and lower-mid portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular semicircular excision on the upper-outer tip of the left lobe; multiple secondary notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
